functions.name: generate_key_pair
functions.description: Generates a public and private key pair using a default seed and returns them as two byte vectors.

functions.name: generate_signature
functions.description: Generates a signature for the provided data using the given private key with Ed25519 compact algorithm.

functions.name: verify_signature
functions.description: Verifies the signature of a given data using the provided public key and returns true if the verification is successful, otherwise false.
